steps.title: Оконные функции, ранжирование и рекурсия
steps.content:
## Окна и CTE

- `ROW_NUMBER` / `RANK` / `DENSE_RANK` — нумерация внутри окна; `RANK` пропускает номера при ничьих, `DENSE_RANK` — нет.
- `LAG`/`LEAD` — предыдущая/следующая строка окна.
- «3+ подряд» — `id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id)` даёт одинаковую группу у последовательных строк.
- `WITH RECURSIVE` — иерархии: уровень = `уровень менеджера + 1`.
- Пара «стран-функция»: параметр N кладётся в таблицу `params` — `LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT n - 1 FROM params)`.

content.caption: PARTITION BY делит строки на независимые окна
content.description: WITH RECURSIVE разворачивает дерево от корня к листьям.

content.description:
Верните N-й по величине **уникальный** оклад как `getNthHighestSalary`; значение `N` лежит в таблице `params` (колонка `n`). Если такого нет — одна строка `NULL`.

[LeetCode 177](https://leetcode.com/problems/nth-highest-salary/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE params(n INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MAX(salary) AS getNthHighestSalary FROM Employee;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT n - 1 FROM params)) AS getNthHighestSalary;

content.description:
Для каждой `score` — `rank` без пропусков (dense rank) по убыванию score. Сортировка по `score` убыв.

[LeetCode 178](https://leetcode.com/problems/rank-scores/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Scores(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, score REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS "rank" FROM Scores ORDER BY score DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS "rank" FROM Scores ORDER BY score DESC;

content.description:
Для дат `2013-10-01`–`2013-10-03`: `Day` и `Cancellation Rate` — доля отменённых поездок (статус ≠ `completed`) среди поездок, где и клиент, и водитель не забанены. Округлить до 2 знаков, сортировка по дате.

[LeetCode 262](https://leetcode.com/problems/trips-and-users/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Trips(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, client_id INTEGER NOT NULL, driver_id INTEGER NOT NULL, city_id INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, request_at TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Users(users_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, banned TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT t.request_at AS Day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Cancellation Rate" FROM Trips t WHERE t.request_at BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-10-03' GROUP BY t.request_at ORDER BY t.request_at;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT t.request_at AS Day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status <> 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Cancellation Rate" FROM Trips t JOIN Users c ON t.client_id = c.users_id AND c.banned = 'No' JOIN Users d ON t.driver_id = d.users_id AND d.banned = 'No' WHERE t.request_at BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-10-03' GROUP BY t.request_at ORDER BY t.request_at;

content.description:
Строки стадиона, где `people >= 100` у **трёх и более** последовательных `id`. Колонки `id`, `visit_date`, `people`; сортировка по `visit_date`.

[LeetCode 601](https://leetcode.com/problems/human-traffic-of-stadium/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Stadium(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, visit_date TEXT NOT NULL, people INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT id, visit_date, people FROM Stadium WHERE people >= 100 ORDER BY visit_date;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH t AS (SELECT id, visit_date, people, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS grp FROM Stadium WHERE people >= 100)
SELECT id, visit_date, people FROM t WHERE grp IN (SELECT grp FROM t GROUP BY grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) ORDER BY visit_date;

content.description:
Студенты, у которых минимум два экзамена по предмету и **последний** балл выше **первого**: `student_id`, `subject`, `first_score`, `latest_score`. Сортировка по `student_id`, `subject`.

[LeetCode 3421](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-students-who-improved/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Scores(student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL, exam_date TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(student_id, subject, exam_date));
content.starterCode: SELECT student_id, subject, MIN(score) AS first_score, MAX(score) AS latest_score FROM Scores GROUP BY student_id, subject;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH ranked AS (SELECT student_id, subject, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, subject ORDER BY exam_date) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, subject ORDER BY exam_date DESC) AS rn_last FROM Scores)
SELECT f.student_id, f.subject, f.score AS first_score, l.score AS latest_score FROM ranked f JOIN ranked l ON f.student_id = l.student_id AND f.subject = l.subject AND f.rn_first = 1 AND l.rn_last = 1 WHERE l.score > f.score ORDER BY f.student_id, f.subject;

content.description:
Для каждого сотрудника: `level` (CEO = 1), `team_size` (все подчинённые, прямые и косвенные), `budget` (свой оклад + оклады всех подчинённых). Колонки `employee_id`, `employee_name`, `level`, `team_size`, `budget`. Сортировка: `level` возр., `budget` убыв., `employee_name` возр.

[LeetCode 3482](https://leetcode.com/problems/analyze-organization-hierarchy/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_name TEXT NOT NULL, manager_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER NOT NULL, department TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id, employee_name, 1 AS level, 0 AS team_size, salary AS budget FROM Employees ORDER BY level, budget DESC, employee_name;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH RECURSIVE pairs(ancestor_id, descendant_id, salary) AS (SELECT employee_id, employee_id, salary FROM Employees
UNION ALL SELECT p.ancestor_id, e.employee_id, e.salary FROM pairs p JOIN Employees e ON e.manager_id = p.descendant_id),
up AS (SELECT descendant_id AS employee_id, COUNT(*) AS level FROM pairs GROUP BY descendant_id),
down AS (SELECT ancestor_id AS employee_id, COUNT(*) - 1 AS team_size, SUM(salary) AS budget FROM pairs GROUP BY ancestor_id)
SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, u.level, d.team_size, d.budget FROM Employees e JOIN up u ON u.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN down d ON d.employee_id = e.employee_id ORDER BY u.level, d.budget DESC, e.employee_name;

content.description:
Самый популярный `category` каждого сезона (Winter: 12/01/02, Spring: 03/04/05, Summer: 06/07/08, Fall: 09/10/11) по сумме `quantity`; при равенстве — по выручке `quantity * price`, затем по алфавиту. Колонки `season`, `category`, `total_quantity`, `total_revenue`; сортировка по `season`.

[LeetCode 3564](https://leetcode.com/problems/seasonal-sales-analysis/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE sales(sale_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, sale_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT 'Fall' AS season, p.category, SUM(s.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(s.quantity * s.price) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.category;

content.description:
Сотрудники (≥ 3 отзыва), у которых **последние три** отзыва строго возрастают: `employee_id`, `name`, `improvement_score` = последний − первый из этих трёх. Сортировка: `improvement_score` убыв., `name` возр.

[LeetCode 3580](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-consistently-improving-employees/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE performance_reviews(review_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, review_date TEXT NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT e.employee_id, e.name, MAX(p.rating) - MIN(p.rating) AS improvement_score FROM employees e JOIN performance_reviews p ON p.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY improvement_score DESC, e.name;

steps.title: 3601. Find Drivers with Improved Fuel Efficiency

content.description:
Водители, у которых средняя эффективность (`distance_km / fuel_consumed`) во **второй** половине года выше, чем в **первой** (янв–июн / июл–дек). Колонки `driver_id`, `driver_name`, `first_half_avg`, `second_half_avg`, `efficiency_improvement` (округлить до 2). Сортировка: улучшение убыв., имя возр.

[LeetCode 3601](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-drivers-with-improved-fuel-efficiency/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE drivers(driver_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, driver_name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE trips(trip_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, driver_id INTEGER NOT NULL, trip_date TEXT NOT NULL, distance_km REAL NOT NULL, fuel_consumed REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode:
WITH halves AS (SELECT driver_id, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', trip_date) AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS half, AVG(distance_km / fuel_consumed) AS avg_eff FROM trips GROUP BY driver_id, half)
SELECT h1.driver_id, d.driver_name, ROUND(h1.avg_eff, 2) AS first_half_avg, ROUND(h2.avg_eff, 2) AS second_half_avg, ROUND(h2.avg_eff - h1.avg_eff, 2) AS efficiency_improvement FROM halves h1 JOIN halves h2 ON h1.driver_id = h2.driver_id AND h1.half = 1 AND h2.half = 2 JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = h1.driver_id ORDER BY efficiency_improvement DESC, d.driver_name;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH halves AS (SELECT driver_id, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', trip_date) AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS half, AVG(distance_km / fuel_consumed) AS avg_eff FROM trips GROUP BY driver_id, half)
SELECT h1.driver_id, d.driver_name, ROUND(h1.avg_eff, 2) AS first_half_avg, ROUND(h2.avg_eff, 2) AS second_half_avg, ROUND(h2.avg_eff - h1.avg_eff, 2) AS efficiency_improvement FROM halves h1 JOIN halves h2 ON h1.driver_id = h2.driver_id AND h1.half = 1 AND h2.half = 2 JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = h1.driver_id WHERE h2.avg_eff > h1.avg_eff ORDER BY efficiency_improvement DESC, d.driver_name;
